requirements.reason: Eight exact published packages, root exports, Node/Bun imports and private-import rejection admitted.
loadConfig and updateConfig are public; Piclaw must translate legacy layers, provenance and quarantine before session construction.
Extension credentials accepts a concrete non-root-exported store; no public keychain-backed credential-store interface.
Server/tool exposure is public, but adapter include/exclude semantics require proved translation and invocation checks.
Direct/deferred/codemode/tool_search and parentToolCallId are public; host policy/late-output checks still require implementation evidence.
Shared resource tools aggregate by server exposure; no public per-server URI/list-result policy seam.
Public calls have inactivity timeout/signal, but extension tool execution exposes no host absolute-deadline abort injection seam.
Every enabled server connects during session_start; deferred/hidden exposure and startupWaitMs do not provide initial lazy lifecycle. Config has no socket transport shape.
Generation gating prevents client, transport, process, listener and tool ownership; a transient constructed object is not explicitly closed and should be corrected and regression-tested.
Low-level public OAuth exists, but extension store/controller is private and non-UI login rejects; openUrl is not headless auth start/complete.
Extension exposes no prompt list/get or MCP App host path and deliberately filters App resources; parallel low-level client is prohibited.
No public extension connection/status observer or reconnect/login/logout controller for host management.
Delegate child bridge requires exact core policy snapshot, explicit factories and one owner; not proven by package imports.
Live Memento execution requires later credential/server-call authorization and all blockers resolved or waived.
Adapter removal, single-owner install and rollback cannot proceed while required public seams remain blocked.
